about.title: About Me
about.intro: I'm <1>Ricardo Carreño Mariño</1>, a Software Engineering graduate from the University of Seville. From March to September 2026, I worked at Impulsa Dirección de Proyectos, where I developed two websites for tourism and civic participation and prepared reports and technical documentation for grant applications and administration.
about.goal: This experience strengthened my interest in building useful, reliable software. In both projects, I worked with authentication, access controls, and Supabase RLS policies.
about.learning: Since September 2026, I have been studying for a University Master's Degree in Cybersecurity at UNIR. I want to keep growing as a software engineer while moving towards application security.
